claims.quote: `man launchd.plist`: launchd runs a missed calendar job at wake and coalesces multiple misses into one run — cron just skips them.

claims.label: supported

If multiple intervals transpire before the computer is woken, those events will be coalesced into one event upon wake from sleep.'
